trajectory.patch:
The Kconfig warnings indicate that `CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE` is not being enabled, even though it is set in `prj.conf`. This is because the Kconfig `choice` for the settings backend now depends on `CONFIG_SETTINGS_RUNTIME`. The tests perform runtime saving of settings, which requires this option to be enabled. Without it, no backend is selected, `CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE` is disabled, and consequently, `CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE_PATH` is not defined and `struct settings_file` is an incomplete type, leading to the compilation errors.

The fix is to explicitly enable `CONFIG_SETTINGS_RUNTIME` in the project configuration file.

tests/subsys/settings/file/prj.conf
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
CONFIG_SETTINGS=y
CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE=y
CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE_PATH="/lfs/settings_file"
========
CONFIG_SETTINGS=y
CONFIG_SETTINGS_RUNTIME=y
CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE=y
CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE_PATH="/lfs/settings_file"
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
